text: : changes “best fit” means. default, fit tries minimise absolute size errors (cubic metres per second). Use lower (typically gauged) limb authoritative need single junction point agree, whole upper curve reshaped. "match_lower_to_upper" lower limb's last row changed: discharge set equal upper limb's first discharge. Use upper limb (e.g. flood-frequency estimate) authoritative junction point needs agree. Use upper limb authoritative whole lower curve, just endpoint, reflect .
